meta.description: Synthetic FMCG P&L dataset for a fictional Italian group. No real or sensitive data: figures are generated from industry benchmark ratios.
meta.value_convention: All values are positive magnitudes; use pnl_lines[].sign to know whether a line adds to or subtracts from the result. Sign 0 marks statistical lines (volume, market) that sit outside the P&L ladder.
meta.grain: One fact per scenario, month, customer, category and line. Lines with customer_level false are held per category only and carry a null customer: the customer P&L stops at contribution margin.
meta.derived_metrics_note: No KPI is precomputed. Promotional pressure, gross-to-net ratio, trade spend efficiency, promo ROI, market share and the price/volume/mix bridge are all derivable from these measures in /js/logic.
